name: tools
description: General-purpose utilities — git workflow helpers (branch cleanup) and n8n workflow automation via the n8n-mcp server (node docs + validation out of the box; add your n8n URL + API key to create, update, and run workflows).

N8N_API_URL.title: n8n instance URL
N8N_API_URL.description: Base URL of your n8n instance, e.g. https://your-instance.app.n8n.cloud or http://localhost:5678. Leave blank for docs-only mode (node documentation + workflow validation, no live instance).

N8N_API_KEY.title: n8n API key
N8N_API_KEY.description: API key from your n8n instance (Settings → n8n API). Enables workflow management tools. Stored in your system keychain, never written to the repo. Leave blank for docs-only mode.
